adventurous: Verbs-forward, trail-ready invites: 'Fuel your frontier', 'Blaze your morning trail', 'Epic days start here'. Second-person, active, outdoor imperatives. Keep It Wild as call to explore.
nourishing: Whole-grain honesty + protein purpose (14g). 'Heirloom recipe, 100% whole grains' — warm parental, never diet jargon. Real food tradition.
rugged: Wasatch-born grit, honest, unpolished but not gruff. Short sentences, light frontier idioms ('keep it wild', 'wilder lives') without cowboy cosplay. #3B2316 brown/ #1A3C34 green anchors trust; #E8530E pop for energy.
guardrails: Use approved claim 'Protein-packed whole grains for today's frontier.' Avoid unsubstantiated % claims (17% class action precedent). Legal/compliance via compliance.py: logo_overlay true, palette probe, prohibited_terms.
localization: US-MW: mountain/snow/trailing haze Wasatch; US-SE: family breakfast, Publix porch, humidity-green, home-anchored. Both rugged but distinct — see briefs/kodiak.yaml vs kodiak-se.yaml.
